# Context Maintenance

## When
After any meaningful coding, debugging, refactor or planning session, before ending.

## Steps
1. `memory-bank/activeContext.md`: current focus, decisions made (with date), open questions, next safe step.
2. `memory-bank/progress.md`: what now exists, what is not built, new risks, completed work.
3. `AGENTS.md`: only if a stable, project-wide rule changed. Keep it under ~60 lines.
4. `CONSTITUTION.md`: only if a non-negotiable changed (owner approval required).
5. `.github/skills/`: add or update a skill if a reusable procedure was discovered.
6. `docs/`: update data contract, domain context or architecture if they changed.

## Never
- Record secrets, tokens, cookies or personal data.
- Record guesses as facts; use `TODO: verify`.
